name: 14TH
description: Examining the historical background and modern application of the 14th Amendment, Ava DuVernay’s 14th  sheds light on the battle around the amendment at a time when it is more relevant and under attack than ever.

name: 2001: A SPACE ODYSSEY
description: Often regarded as one of the best films ever made, Kubrick’s mind-bending masterpiece explores the magnitudes of space, time, and existence, presented here in stunning 70mm.

name: 5 MORE MINUTES
description: Time is of the essence for a crumbling marriage when an attempt at reconciliation via a country getaway goes spectacularly awry after the feuding couple and their host find themselves trapped in an increasingly destructive time loop.

name: A LONG WINTER
description: After his mother goes missing in a snowstorm, Mike faces the unrelenting winter in the mountains to find her in this emotionally stirring film from acclaimed director Andrew Haigh (All of Us Strangers).

name: A TALENT FOR MURDER
description: An ambitious agent journeys to the Swiss home of reclusive author Patricia Highsmith (Helen Mirren) to persuade the creator of literature’s Tom Ripley to write one last novel at any cost in director Anton Corbijn’s wickedly fun psychological thriller.

name: ADULT SUPERVISION
description: It’s a chaotic exploration of masculine fragility gone wild in this dark psycho-comedy about three doting fathers volunteering as chaperones for their daughters’ class camping trip to a secluded Swedish island.

name: AH GIRL
description: In this tender coming-of-age dramedy, a 7-year-old girl shuttles between her separated parents' homes in 1994, quietly working out why the adults around her refuse to tell her the truth.

name: ALL OF A SUDDEN
description: A chance encounter changes the lives of two women forever in Ryusuke Hamaguchi’s magnificent new film about the radical act of compassion and the transcendental effects art can have on self and community.

name: ANIMATED SHORTS PROGRAM
description: Includes : Cartoon Physics / Marble & Lemons / Terminal / Ivar / Busy Bodies / Because Today is Saturday / The End / Living with a Visionary

name: ARRESTED MEMORY
description: An absurdist throwback to the early films of Takashi Miike, Arrested Memory is a detective caper unlike any you’ve seen before, with a lead who doesn't even remember he’s a detective.

name: BEDFORD PARK
description: Following a car accident, two Korean Americans, each burdened by a troubled past, are brought together and form an unlikely romance in this tender debut feature.

name: BEHEMOTH!
description: In a career-best performance, Pedro Pascal astounds as a cellist confronting his past and the lives he’s lived in Tony Gilroy’s sweeping symphonic elegy to the silver screen.

name: BEING HEUMANN
description: Disability rights activist Judy Heumann and her band of co-conspirators break out of the margins to boldly stage a 26-day-long occupation of a federal building in director Siân Heder’s moving follow up to Coda.

name: BEN'IMANA
description: Guiding her community towards healing after genocide, a Rwandan woman faces a personal reckoning when her daughter's unexpected pregnancy forces history's wounds into her own home.

name: BIG PHAN
description: He’s a big, furry creature from Broad Street. The Phillie Phanatic finally gets his close-up in a biopic capturing the magic and mayhem of a baseball legend.

name: BITTER CHRISTMAS
description: Playfully moving between stories within stories, Pedro Almodovar’s latest is a layered exploration of success and failure, friendship and loss, and the sometimes razor-thin line between reality and fiction.

name: BOATBUILDERS
description: Witness the indelible beauty of skilled craftsmanship on a picturesque outcrop of New England and visit the lives and struggles of the laborers and artisans who build the finest ships on the sea in this engrossing documentary.

name: BRIAN
description: In this uproarious coming-of-age comedy, a socially hapless teen runs for class president to spend more time with the teacher he’s crushing on, recruiting the school’s magnetic new kid to be his campaign manager in the process.

name: BUNKER
description: Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz deliver powerful performances in this gripping domestic drama about an architect whose latest project opens fault lines in his seemingly perfect marriage.

name: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR STUFF
description: Before there was Neil deGrasse Tyson, there was Carl Sagan, the scientist who first brought the cosmos into American living rooms and invited viewers to wonder about the vast universe beyond Earth.
aliases: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR...
CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF...
canonical_title: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR STUFF

name: CHILI FINGER
description: When a cash-strapped lawyer finds a finger in her fast-food chili, she sees an answer to her problems, but a demand for payment sparks a darkly comic game of wits and escalating bad decisions.

name: CLARISSA
description: An affluent woman's extravagant party brings former friends and lovers back into her orbit in this alluring reimagining of Virginia Woolf's Mrs. Dalloway starring Sophie Okonedo.

name: CLOSE ENCOUNTERS OF THE THIRD KIND
description: In an infinite expanse of stars, one surely ponders: are we alone? Join PFF35 as you look back up at the sky through Steven Spielberg’s eyes on glorious 70mm film. This means something. This is important.
canonical_title: CLOSE ENCOUNTERS OF THE THIRD KIND

name: CLOSING NIGHT PARTY
description: It’s a wrap! Presented by iHeart Radio, celebrate the 35th Philadelphia Film Festival with other festivalgoers, award winners, guests and more as we look back on 11 days of storytelling at its finest. Enjoy complimentary drinks and bites, with music by DJ Queen Kev! 21+. $50 General Admission, $40 PFS members for Film & Party.

name: CLUB KID
description: After a decade throwing the hottest, drug-fuelled parties in New York City, nothing could cure Peter’s permanent hangover until the son he never knew he had showed up at his door and sobered him right up in triple-threat Jordan Firstman’s hilariously raunchy, yet tenderly sweet debut.

name: CONGO BOY
description: In this stirring coming-of-age drama, a 17-year-old boy seeking refuge in Bangui juggles raising his younger siblings alone while chasing his dream of a music career, one song, odd job, and stage at a time.

name: COWARD
description: Belgian auteur Lukas Dhont returns with a graceful, heartbreaking tale of young soldiers whose fragile connection is tested by the devastating machinery of war on the frontlines of WWI.

name: DOCUMENTARY SHORTS PROGRAM
description: Includes: Erucation / Still Standing / Luigi / Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy / Jimmy's Custom Coffin / Escalation

name: DOWNBEAT
description: After failing out of the industry and losing his groove, a scrappy drummer is left with a bucket, the corner he busks on, and the family he’s been trying to forget.

name: ELEPHANTS IN THE FOG
description: In a rural Nepalese village, surrounded by lush forests and wild elephants, the matriarch of a transgender community has her life upended when her adopted daughter disappears. In her quest to find her, she risks the tenuous safety of her people as well as her own life in this mystery thriller.

name: ELSINORE
description: Andrew Scott gives a career-best performance in the stirring true story of actor Ian Charleson, who bravely took on the most challenging role of his career while battling AIDS.

name: EVERYTIME
description: This haunting and thrillingly ambitious drama finds a grieving single mom, her precocious daughter, and a mixed-up teenage boy forming an unlikely trio as they attempt to make sense of tragedy.

name: EXTRA GEOGRAPHY
description: At a girls’ boarding school in England, inseparable best mates Flic and Minna make it their mission to fall in love with the same person at the same time. What could possibly go wrong?

name: FATHERLAND
description: Sandra Hüller delivers a powerfully restrained performance as the daughter of writer Thomas Mann in this immaculately crafted drama following the expat author’s tumultuous return to Germany after WWII.

name: FILMADELPHIA SHORTS PROGRAM
description: Includes: Philly Pretzels / The Second Life of Freddie Nole / Deuce Purgatory / Six Sixty Six / Casualty / Fletcher Street / The Wonka of Worcester

name: FILMMAKER MEET UP
description: Join the local filmmaking community to network and pitch your projects to make something happen! Grab a coffee, connect with other local creators, and browse local brands and organizations that can help bring your projects to life. Free event.

name: FIRST THEY CAME FOR MY COLLEGE
description: As political appointees remake a celebrated Florida college from the top down, students and faculty fight to preserve its distinctive culture, academic freedom, and the place they call home.
canonical_title: FIRST THEY CAME FOR MY COLLEGE

name: FJORD
description: Part searing family drama, part captivating legal thriller, this Cannes-winning Romanian film follows a conservative couple clashing with Norwegian child protection laws.

name: FLIES
description: In search of some extra cash, solitary Olga rents out a room in her apartment. The arrangement seems simple enough until an awfully persistent little intruder slips in, changing her life forever.

name: GENTLE BY BIRTH
description: After her brother’s death, director Doree Simon Hatfield digs into the realities of stigma, harm reduction, and addiction in America, confronting the toll it takes on families like her own.

name: GOODBYE CRUEL WORLD
description: Anatomy of a Fall’s Milo Machado-Graner leads this beautifully 16mm-shot coming-of-age romance about a fed-up, bullied teen staging a disappearing act and the only lonely girl who knows his secret.

name: GROUND FLOOR
description: Just before departing for a holiday with his wife, Kristóf discovers black mold in their apartment. What starts as a simple inquiry into how the mold got there turns into a building-wide conspiracy in this surreal political satire.

name: HALF
description: One of the most wild late-night films in years pits two half-vampire siblings against a nefarious and gruesome roadside scavenger cabal in a bloody martial arts western destined for instant cult classic status.

name: HANGING BY A WIRE
description: A routine commute turns into a nightmare when eight passengers are stranded in a cable car hanging by a single line above a mountainous Pakistani valley, triggering a remarkable rescue attempt.

name: I DON'T WANT TO DRINK YOUR BLOOD ANYMORE
description: A reclusive vampire fighting her thirst for blood finds her carefully isolated life disrupted by unexpected visitors, forcing her to confront the violent nature she has spent decades resisting.
aliases: I DON'T WANT TO DRINK YOUR BLOOD...
canonical_title: I DON’T WANT TO DRINK YOUR BLOOD ANYMORE

name: I SEE BUILDINGS FALL LIKE LIGHTNING
description: Inseparable since childhood, five mates confront their thirties with varying degrees of happiness and success in Clio Barnard’s bruising, big-hearted look at friendship in working-class Britain.
canonical_title: I SEE BUILDINGS FALL LIKE LIGHTNING

name: I'LL BE GONE IN JUNE
description: A German study abroad student lands in a small New Mexico town just as America is transformed by 9/11 in this wryly observant and gorgeously shot coming-of-age film.

name: IN WAVES
description: A young romance blooms between a shy skateboarder and an adventurous surfer until sudden illness changes everything in this animated adaptation brought to life by director Phuong Mai Nguyen.

name: INK
description: What happens when Rupert Murdoch offers control of a flailing newspaper to a discontented editor hell-bent on upending the industry? The tabloid is born, and the news will never be the same.

name: IRON BOY
description: In this animated watercolor gem, an 11-year-old boy in rural France begins collapsing without warning until an iron corset tears him away from the only world he has ever known.

name: JEAN-MICHEL BASQUIAT
description: Nearly 40 years after his untimely passing, Jean-Michel Basquiat’s family looks back at the life and blazing talent of one of the 20th century’s most celebrated and influential artists.

name: JOSEPHINE
description: In this powerful Sundance top prize winner starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan, 8-year-old Josephine witnesses a brutal attack, leaving her changed in unexpected ways that her loving parents struggle to make sense of.

name: JOY WILL PREVAIL
description: Architect Louis Kahn (Griffin Dunne) reluctantly takes on a country home for a tenacious businessman, sparking an unlikely friendship and a project that challenges both men to reconsider how they want to live.

name: KIKUYU LAND
description: One man’s fight to reclaim his family’s stolen land leads to a probing investigation of Kenya’s tea industry, exposing how colonial-era land theft still shapes wealth, labor, and ownership today.

name: KWAIDAN
description: Four macabre tales from Japanese folklore comprise Masaki Kobayashi’s legendary 1964 anthology, resurrected in all its otherworldly beauty in a brand-new 4K restoration.

name: LA BOLA NEGRA
description: Set before, during, and after the transformative Spanish Civil War, La Bola Negra is an operatic historical epic that tells the story of three men fundamentally connected by a shared history of love, loss, and inheritance across three distinct time periods: 1932, 1937, and 2017.

name: LA GRADIVA
description: Achingly beautiful and shot on 16mm, French filmmaker Marine Atlan’s beguiling coming-of-age debut about a French high school trip to the ruins of Pompeii is an epic, yet strikingly intimate, story of self-discovery, disappointment, and yearning.

name: LABRADOR — AUTOPSY OF SILENCE
description: An icy murder mystery set aboard a vast freighter at sea serves as the framework for this moody tale of colonization and sexuality.

name: LABRADOR— AUTOPSY OF SILENCE
description: An icy murder mystery set aboard a vast freighter at sea serves as the framework for this moody tale of colonization and sexuality.

name: LE FAUX SOIR
description: Inspired by the unbelievable true story during the German occupation of Belgium, Le Faux Soir is a historical thriller paired with dark humor and the trappings of a heist film.

name: LOOK BACK
description: Bright-eyed Fujino and bashful Kyomoto form an ineffable bond over their shared love for drawing manga, setting the young artists on unforeseen courses beyond their wildest imaginations.

name: LOVE IS THE MONSTER
description: A chilling dystopian thriller presenting a tense, deeply unsettling vision of society, Love Is the Monster explores the complexities of family and contemplates the moral question of how far a person might go to protect the people they love.

name: MAKING MARIE ANTOINETTE
description: Marie Antoinette turns 20 with a never-before-seen portrait of Sofia Coppola at work, captured through her mother Eleanor’s tentative gaze as the young director radically reinvents Versailles.

name: MEMBER APPRECIATION BRUNCH
description: Cap off your first weekend at PFF35 with a brunch just for PFS members. Stop in, catch up with your friends at PFS, and plan the rest of your Festival experience over specialty breakfast cocktails from Philadelphia Distilling, plus coffee and bites from La Colombe. Please present your membership card or digital membership confirmation at the door.

name: MINOTAUR
description: Recently deemed a foreign agent by his own country, Russia’s master of cinema Andrey Zvyagintsev returns with a venomous, impeccably composed thriller that reimagines Claude Chabrol’s The Unfaithful Life at the outset of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

name: MOUSE
description: A touching coming-of-age drama, Mouse gracefully examines friendship, grief, and teenage identity in this powerful follow up to 2024’s Ghostlight.

name: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART I — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW
description: One of the most universally lauded documentaries in recent years, this immense and important portrait probes the invasion of Ukraine through the lenses of the independent journalists trying to report the truth with integrity.
canonical_title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART I – LAST AIR IN MOSCOW

name: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II — EXILE
description: In this monumental second part of her documentary, filmmaker Julia Loktev continues her work by following the endangered journalists who are targets of Putin’s regime.
canonical_title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE

name: NARRATIVE SHORTS PROGRAM
description: Includes: We Were Here / A Crime Across Four Landscapes / Spiritus Sanctus / Gamberra / Nobody Said Anything / Crisis Actor / The Dream is a Snail

name: NAZA
description: The co-directors of 2024’s No Other Land return with an explosive look into the systems used to target Palestinians during Israel’s military operations in Gaza.

name: NEVER AFTER DARK
description: Playing within the confines of a traditional Japanese ghost story, PFF fave Dave Boyle (Man From Reno, PFF23) returns with a bone-chilling tale of a medium hired to investigate a strange occurrence at an isolated country home.

name: NO SEQUELS REQUIRED: A SINGLES MIXER
description: Calling all singles ready to mingle! Come meet your match, for all romantic and platonic interests. Featuring DJ Ciara Chaii, be ready to engage and leave with a new friend or maybe more.
canonical_title: NO SEQUELS REQUIRED: A SINGLES MIXER

name: NUISANCE BEAR
description: Tourism, climate change, and human hubris complicate the ancient migration of a young polar bear, exposing the consequences of trying to control the wild rather than respect it in this beautifully framed documentary.

name: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: In this monumental posthumous documentary from William Greaves, legendary voices of the Harlem Renaissance gather at Duke Ellington’s townhouse in 1972 to reminisce, debate, and pass on the wisdom of a generation that reshaped American culture.
canonical_title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM

name: OPENING NIGHT PARTY
description: Presented by Cherry Hill Imports Auto Group, buckle up for an unforgettable night of food, drinks and plenty of fun featuring DJ Dommis, live art by Lawren Alice, a whiskey tasting by Dad’s Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey, with special guest Letterboxd and more!

name: PAPER TIGER
description: Auteur James Gray’s latest masterpiece is a compelling tale of ambition gone wrong in search of the American Dream.

name: PFF FILM TRIVIA NIGHT!
description: Join fellow film buffs across the city for a fun evening of testing your best film knowledge. Hosted by Johnny Goodtimes, come solo or with a team, grab a drink and meet new film buddies! Prizes courtesy of LITTLE MOVIE STORE. Please keep teams no more than 6.

name: PFS LOVES PHILLY ARTS MARKET!
description: Shop, browse, and connect with local Philly artisans featuring handmade goods crafted with love. Come early, grab a drink from MADIS, and support our local creative community.

name: POSSIBLE LOVE
description: Blue-collar Mi-Ok and Ho-seok fall in with cosmopolitans Ye-ji and Sang-woo, awakening long-suppressed desires and discontentment as the possibility of another life lingers tantalizingly close in Korean auteur Lee Chang-Dong’s (Burning, Secret Sunshine) latest masterpiece.

name: QUEEN AT SEA
description: When a woman with advanced dementia becomes the center of a bitter family dispute over care and consent, those who love her most are forced to confront who has the right to decide what is best.

name: RAISE THE RED LANTERN
description: The red spectre of Zhang Yimou’s epochal 1991 masterpiece of feudal oppression and domestic tyranny is presented in a brand new, lustrous 4K restoration.

name: RAY GUNN
description: From Academy Award–winning writer-director Brad Bird (The Incredibles, The Iron Giant), Ray Gunn is a highly stylized science fiction noir that blends a classic hard-boiled detective drama with dazzling spectacle and sharp humor.

name: REHEARSALS FOR A REVOLUTION
description: An Iranian filmmaker and activist looks back on the people who shaped her, transforming their private stories into a broader study of Iran’s long struggle for change and enduring hope.

name: RIDER
description: A young bike courier's New Year's Eve delivery leads to an unexpected romance, but class, circumstance, and a sudden turn threaten to keep the young lovers apart in this contemporary musical.

name: SALVATION
description: In a secluded Turkish village, a leader's brother is gripped by seemingly prophetic visions, sparking religious paranoia and chaos that threatens the entire community.

name: SEIZED
description: Equally hilarious and unsettling, this astonishing documentary traces the unfounded police raid that transformed an unassuming Midwestern newsroom into the unlikely center of a national debate over the First Amendment.

name: SENTIENT
description: Primate testing has driven medical breakthroughs, but as science evolves and technology advances, many ask whether experimentation on our closest animal relatives still has a place in medicine.

name: SICK
description: An intense and frequently inappropriate sibling dynamic is salaciously explored in this unhinged coming-of-age story about a brother and sister who are sent off to the countryside to take care of their ailing grandmother but seem to have more interest in each other.

name: TANGLES
description: Just as Sarah is beginning to build an adult life of her own, her mother’s Alzheimer’s diagnosis forces her to navigate caregiving, duty, and the slow grief of losing someone still beside her.

name: TENDER LOVING CARE
description: Mike Leigh’s swan song is a compassionate, clear-eyed look at friendship and family, featuring remarkable performances from a cast including Widow’s Bay breakout Kate O’Flynn.

name: TEST
description: An aspiring bodybuilder’s relentless pursuit of perfection collides with his burgeoning queer desires in this sexy, sensitive drama, written by and starring breakout Brock Yurich.

name: THE ASSASSIN(S)
description: Based on the attempted assassination of South Korean President Park Chung-hee, The Assassin(s) is a gripping historical conspiracy thriller in the vein of JFK with a bit of Spotlight and Chinatown sprinkled in.

name: THE BLOW
description: The looming release of their troubled father from jail divides siblings Enzo and Carla, forcing the two to confront their deep-seated pain in Julien Gaspar-Oliveri’s evocative and powerful drama.

name: THE BURNING GIANTS
description: As a mysterious poisonous fog drifts across the mountains and threatens inhabitants, Thai authorities attempt to remove the last remaining member of the Indigenous Karen people in this hypnotic and surreal dystopian drama.

name: THE CYCLE
description: Delicately balancing a variety of genres, The Cycle is a slow-burn crime procedural that transforms from what seems to be a serial killer thriller into something more unexpected.

name: THE DEBUT
description: Julianne Moore gives a career-defining performance as a New Jersey housewife determined to do whatever it takes to make it big in her local community theater.

name: THE DIARY OF A CHAMBERMAID
description: The latest from provocateur Radu Jude playfully transplants Mirbeau’s classic satire to contemporary France, where a Romanian maid strives for a better life amid precarious circumstances.

name: THE DREAMED ADVENTURE
description: An archaeologist is pulled back into the criminal underworld of her past in southeast Bulgaria when her friend—and former lover—goes missing without a trace in Valeska Grisebach’s award-winning gangster epic.

name: THE HAUNTING OF PENNHURST
description: At a former institution for people with disabilities, a haunted attraction employs disabled performers who confront the site’s abusive past while reclaiming its story on their own terms.
director: NATHAN STENBERG, MIKE ATTIE, KATARINA POLJAK

name: THE LAST CRITIC
description: Still writing and reviewing after six decades, self-anointed “Dean of American Rock Critics” Robert Christgau reflects on his career in this warm, witty celebration of music criticism.

name: THE LIFE AND DEATHS OF WILSON SHEDD
description: Amanda Seyfried shines as a teacher who finds an unexpected connection with an inmate through their mutual love of poetry and literature in this powerful prison drama from director Tim Blake Nelson.
aliases: THE LIFE AND DEATHS OF WILSON...
canonical_title: THE LIFE AND DEATHS OF WILSON SHEDD

name: THE MATCH
description: Forty years after the world witnessed the “Hand of God,” The Match returns to the legendary 1986 World Cup quarter-final between England and Argentina with a riveting reconstruction of the mythical showdown from every angle.

name: THE MELTDOWN
description: In this taut and atmospheric mystery set at a snowbound Andean resort, a lonely young girl’s fascination with a teenage guest takes on dark contours when the older girl goes missing.

name: THE OLDEST PERSON IN THE WORLD
description: Director Sam Green’s childhood obsession with the Guinness Book of World Records leads to a decade-long project interviewing each person who holds the inevitably finite title of world’s oldest living person.
canonical_title: THE OLDEST PERSON IN THE WORLD

name: THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN N.Y.
description: A love letter to old-school New York, The Only Living Pickpocket in New York is both a captivating character study and a compelling crime drama about an aging pickpocket who gets himself in over his head.
canonical_title: THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK

name: THE ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW
description: After more than 50 years and countless midnight screenings, get ready to laugh, sing, and shout through one of the most enduring and iconic cult films of all time, in honor of the late, great Tim Curry.

name: TIME WARP
description: Twenty-five-year-old Kenny Starling launches Rock Springs' first drag and queer theater company in order to bring the beloved Rocky Horror Picture Show and its vibrancy and rebellion to rural Wyoming.

name: TOO MANY BEASTS
description: Brimming with hogs and hilarity, this pitch-black comedy finds an unstable cop getting entangled in a local mystery after a feud between farmers and a boar-hunting group comes to a head.

name: UGLY CRY
description: An aspiring Hollywood actress is told after an audition that she has an "ugly cry." That single, scathing comment unravels her career, her sense of self, and eventually, her grip on reality.

name: VERTIGINOUS
description: From the gonzo mind of Quentin Dupieux, Vertiginous is a sharp satire that confronts the question of whether reality as we know it is really real.

name: VICTORIAN PSYCHO
description: Thrilling, hilarious, and drenched in blood, this killer Victorian slasher comedy stars indie scream queen Maika Monroe as the mysterious visiting governess at an English manor will keep you guessing, gasping, and laughing.

name: VIVA CARMEN
description: In this ravishing animated adaptation of Bizet's opera, a blind knife grinder's blades reveal Carmen's tragic fate, sending a young boy and a band of misfit street kids racing to rewrite destiny.

name: WE ARE ALIENS
description: Kohei Kadowaki’s feature directorial debut traces a beautiful friendship that blossoms between two schoolboys, and the moment of betrayal that shatters it, sending the consequences rippling across the rest of their lives.

name: WE ARE ALL STRANGERS
description: Two generations deal with love, loss, and hardship in this masterful portrait of family from acclaimed Singaporean auteur Anthony Chen (THE BREAKING ICE PFF32, ILO ILO PFF22).

name: WE ARE THE SHAGGS
description: After decades of baffling and fascinating listeners with loopy ditties like “My Pal Foot Foot,” sister trio The Shaggs finally gets a chance to tell their story in this affectionate and hilarious deep dive into one of the most misunderstood bands of all time.

name: WHEN A WITNESS RECANTS
description: Three Black teenagers wrongfully convicted of a 1983 murder spend decades incarcerated before the truth eventually emerges, exposing a fractured justice system built on coerced child witnesses and the unfortunate cost of stolen lives.

name: WHO KILLED ALEX ODEH?
description: Palestinian-American activist Alex Odeh’s murder has remained unsolved for more than four decades, but this gripping investigation pursues the truth in its search for long-denied justice.

name: WICKER
description: Audacious and absurd, equal parts fable, fantasy, comedy, and romance, Wicker delivers one of the most quirky and original love stories in recent cinema.

name: WILD HORSE NINE
description: After a life of subterfuge and espionage, a retiring CIA agent (John Malkovich) is looking to be a bit more honest during a final dispatch to Easter Island in 1973, much to the dismay of his partner (Sam Rockwell) and bureau chief (Steve Buscemi) in Martin McDonagh’s sardonic dark comedy.

name: WOLFRAM
description: In a brutal western about extraordinary circumstances and incredible perseverance, Aboriginal children, forced to work for settlers colonizing the inhospitable outback, devise their daring escape.

name: WRITTEN ON THE WIND
description: The delirious apex of Douglas Sirk’s Technicolor 1950s melodramas, this saga of sexual frustration and family discord exposes the rot at the heart of an unraveling Texan oil clan. Presented by You Must Remember This podcaster Karina Longworth.

name: YALE
description: With her son's life on the line, a desperate mother forces her way back into the life of her deadbeat father, joining him on an unlikely road trip to find a kidney donor for her son.

name: YELLOW LETTERS
description: This Berlinale prizewinner is an absorbing look at an artist couple who must either sacrifice their morals in the face of fascism or choose to put their family, careers, and marriage in danger.

name: YOUNG FRIENDS DANCE PARTY
description: Join us for our annual Young Friends Dance Party, featuring DJ Daniel Giangrandi! Enjoy a night of nostalgic throwbacks from the 90s and early aughts, mingle and dance with other film lovers, and indulge in light bites provided by Las Bugambilias and specialty cocktails from Philadelphia Distilling. Free with proof of Festival badge or ticket; 21+ with valid ID.
